metrics.label: Indonesia food-delivery market
metrics.sourceNote: 2026 publication reporting 2025 estimates. Public article text reviewed; paid chart data not accessed.
metrics.definition: Estimated food orders received by restaurants or app partner businesses, including cancelled orders; market GMV, not platform net revenue.
caveats: Estimated market values and shares; not audited issuer revenue or transaction disclosures.
18% growth is reported by the 2026 report coverage; rounded US$5.4bn and US$6.4bn values yield a different calculation. Preserve reported growth rather than recomputing false precision.
Shares refer to food-delivery GMV, not ride-hailing, parcels, all ODS or customer preference surveys.
metrics.gotoImplication: GoFood share falls from 38% in 2023 to 31% in 2025 while the market expands. Test city-level retention, order frequency and contribution margins before attributing the loss to price or service quality.

metrics.sourceName: Momentum Works — Ecommerce in Southeast Asia 2026, public report appendix
metrics.label: Indonesia platform-commerce market
metrics.sourceNote: Country GMV and share chart visually verified in public PDF appendix, report pages 10 and 13. PDF text extraction omits these image charts.
metrics.definition: Covered major-platform paid ecommerce orders, including cancelled, returned and refunded orders; excludes non-platform channels.
caveats: Rounded source shares total 101%; do not normalize them to 100% or imply greater precision.
TikTok Shop and Tokopedia are combined in the Indonesia country chart. The 3% share is Blibli, not Tokopedia.
GMV is not merchant revenue, order count, payment processed value or courier allocation.
USD growth can reflect exchange-rate changes. Not directly comparable with Google/Temasek/Bain ecommerce estimates using a different scope.
metrics.gotoImplication: Commerce demand is concentrated in Shopee and TikTok Shop/Tokopedia. Map actual GoSend, payment and lending integrations separately: platform GMV share alone does not establish GoTo delivery allocation or payment share.

metrics.label: Indonesia passenger ride-hailing share
metrics.sourceName: ABI Research — Ride Hailing Market Data public release
metrics.sourceNote: Primary research publisher public release states GMV shares and combined trip-volume concentration separately.
metrics.definition: Passenger ride-hailing across two- and four-wheel modalities. Shares by GMV, not food delivery or trip volume.
caveats: Partial source disclosure: named shares total 91.6%; remaining providers are not broken out. Do not renormalize the two companies to 100%.
Grab and Gojek together account for 89% of trip volumes; that measure is distinct from their 91.6% combined GMV share.
This is H1 2025, published March 2026; not a current October 2026 share measurement.
Source attributes the GMV/trip-volume difference to the four-wheel modality mix. No standalone Indonesia market dollar value is disclosed.
metrics.gotoImplication: Track both ride counts and booking value by two-wheel versus car. A higher GMV share can reflect a higher-value modal mix rather than more trips.

metrics.label: Digital payment transactions
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: Mobile/internet banking and server-based e-money transactions.
caveats: Broad payment measure; not wallet-only TAM, unique users or rupiah transaction value.
July release footnote describes mobile/internet apps; August explicitly adds server-based e-money. Check statistical scope before interpreting a change between releases.
Only reported observations retained; June is missing.
metrics.gotoImplication: Track payment adoption and usage frequency alongside monetization.

metrics.label: QRIS transaction volume growth
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: Annual growth in QRIS transaction count.
caveats: A growth rate, not transaction value, wallet share or merchant count.
Unreported June observation is absent.
metrics.gotoImplication: Compare merchant payment usage growth with acquisition and retention economics.

metrics.label: QRIS users
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: QRIS user reach reported at FEKDI/IFSE.
caveats: Source paragraph does not explicitly assign this adoption stock to an August month-end; retained as reported September.
Not GoPay users or exclusive wallet users.
metrics.gotoImplication: Benchmark payment reach without treating registered reach as active paying users.

metrics.label: QRIS merchants
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: QRIS merchant acceptance reported at FEKDI/IFSE.
caveats: Reported adoption count, not active unique corporate merchant entities or platform market share.
Publication date and measurement cut-off may differ.
metrics.gotoImplication: Assess acceptance opportunity and overlap with merchant software distribution.

metrics.label: BI-FAST retail transfers
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: Retail transfer count processed through BI-FAST.
caveats: Infrastructure throughput; not payment gateway revenue.

metrics.label: BI-FAST transfer value
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
caveats: Transfer value is not revenue; do not add to platform TPV.
metrics.gotoImplication: Assess transfer rail scale and potential unit-fee pressure.

metrics.label: Pindar financing outstanding
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: Outstanding financing in OJK online-lending industry.
caveats: Outstanding balance, not annual originations or total Indonesian consumer credit.
GoTo loan book includes consumer/merchant loans and channeling; this is not a matching share denominator.
Release dated 5 October; English webpage dated 8 October.
metrics.gotoImplication: Assess credit demand alongside delinquency before extending distribution.

metrics.label: Pindar TWP90
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: Aggregate 90-day default ratio in regulated online lending.
caveats: Industry aggregate; not GoPay NPL and not directly comparable with every issuer NPL definition.
metrics.gotoImplication: Track credit deterioration separately from outstanding growth.

metrics.label: Finance-company BNPL outstanding
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: BNPL financing by finance companies reported through SLIK.
caveats: Finance-company scope only; excludes bank BNPL.
Not a single-provider addressable revenue pool.
metrics.gotoImplication: Size regulated finance-company BNPL separately from bank BNPL.

metrics.label: Finance-company BNPL gross NPF
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: Gross problem-financing ratio in finance-company BNPL.
caveats: Different population from bank BNPL and Pindar TWP90.

metrics.label: Bank BNPL outstanding
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: Bank BNPL balance recorded in SLIK.
caveats: Bank BNPL only; separate from finance-company BNPL.
Accounts across providers are not unique borrowers.
metrics.gotoImplication: Monitor bank-funded competition in point-of-sale credit.

metrics.label: Bank BNPL accounts
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
caveats: Accounts are not unique persons or monthly active users.
metrics.gotoImplication: Benchmark credit-account penetration without assuming exclusive borrowers.

metrics.label: Banking credit outstanding
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
metrics.definition: Total banking credit reported by OJK.
caveats: Economy-wide bank lending, not digital-bank TAM or GoPay lending share denominator.
metrics.gotoImplication: Context for funding partnerships and consumer/merchant credit capacity.

metrics.label: Banking third-party funds
metrics.sourceNote: Original regulator release reviewed; reporting period differs from publication date.
caveats: All banking deposits, not digital-bank-only deposits.
metrics.gotoImplication: Monitor deposit competition and partner funding conditions.

coverageGaps: No complete platform-specific financing, advertising or merchant-software market shares are publicly disclosed in these sources.
Lazada wallet/payment methods require further current Indonesia checkout documentation; only source-verified Kredivo and LazPayLater/Akulaku financing links are retained.
Tokopedia/TikTok external financing and seller-software partner coverage remains partial.
Grab driver lending is documented separately from merchant financing; this pass does not verify every current GrabModal merchant lender.
Blibli’s other cardless-credit providers and all provider eligibility are not exhaustively enumerated.

services.title: Two-wheel rides
services.note: Driver availability, fare / promo, cancellations, safety and commission economics.

services.title: Car & taxi
services.note: Compare route, city and vehicle class; fleet ownership and partner models differ.

services.title: Food delivery
services.note: Order frequency, incentives, basket size, merchant economics and fulfilment reliability.

services.title: Parcel delivery
services.note: Speed, coverage, claims, merchant use and cost per delivery.

services.title: Groceries
services.note: On-demand marketplace, rapid grocery and retailer fulfilment are distinct models.

services.title: Goods & business logistics
services.note: Payload, vehicle class, business delivery, route density and available cities.

services.title: Driver EV ecosystem
services.note: Adjacent ecosystem: compare vehicle financing, swap access and driver total cost. Not a pure ride-hailing share comparison.

services.title: Consumer wallet
services.note: QRIS usage, payment reliability, transfers, refunds and customer support; survey penetration is not transaction share.

services.title: Pay later
services.note: Compare licensed lending entities, approval, affordability, repayment quality and distribution.

services.title: Consumer cash loans
services.note: Loan approval, disclosures, collections, cost of risk and funding; complaints are allegations.

services.title: Payment gateway
services.note: Net fees, acceptance methods, checkout conversion, uptime, settlement and merchant integrations.

services.title: Merchant software / POS
services.note: Merchant SaaS and POS alternatives; modules and target customer sizes differ. Software is not a wallet.

services.title: Merchant payments
services.note: Merchant onboarding, QRIS, settlement, reconciliation and service costs.

services.title: Savings / banking
services.note: Bank Jago is a GoTo associate / partner. Compare deposits, funding costs, capital and credit quality; partner app feedback differs from the GoPay product.

services.title: SME finance
services.note: Adjacent capital providers: borrower segment and lending model must match before comparison.

services.title: Identity & risk infrastructure
services.note: Infrastructure / partner candidates, not automatically direct GoTo competitors. Evaluate KYC, fraud controls and integration.

methodology: Public company and partner documentation maps documented relationships, not transaction allocation. Sector estimates, issuer reports, flow metrics and outstanding balances remain separately defined. No impact percentage is inferred from an integration or market share.
